expect.why: TEST_INTERFACE.md, Exit status: a non-zero exit means an *input document* was malformed, and 'on a non-zero exit the tool must not leave a partial --output.result file behind. That distinction is scored.' The input here is a signed type-4 envelope cut off mid-payload -- RLP that will not decode. The case is scored on the refusal, on the absence of --output.result and on the absence of --output.alloc; there is no result document to compare.

source.why: Scored by t8ncheck.py's `expect.exit_nonzero`, which is the only expectation of its kind in this step. Every other case requires exit 0.
